author: mark
text:
v0.3 tool executor: SpawnTool + per-call disk record

Real ToolExecutor for the v0.3 tools epic, behind a trait the
multi-step loop (bl-9221) will plumb into prompt::Deps. Implements
ARCH §3.3 end to end: stdio contract (stdin verbatim; stdout to
tool_result.content; stderr concatenated on non-zero exit;
KilledBySignal for non-SIGTERM faults per §2.10), disk record
(input.json + output.json under steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/tools/<tool-id>/
via temp-path + atomic rename), and SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL cascade with
the §3.3 5s deadline.

Resolution mirrors §4.4 adapter discovery:
1. <harness_root>/tools/lernie-tool-<name>
2. lernie-tool-<name> on PATH
3. In-process fallback: current_exe() invoked as `lernie tool <name>`

Cancellation polls a stop AtomicBool every 50ms; stdout/stderr capture
runs on background threads so a stuck pipe cannot deadlock the wait
loop. Tests inject a BinaryResolver to drive the PATH and in-process
hops without mutating the live process env (edition 2024's set_var is
unsafe and racy under parallel cargo test).

31 new tests, 100% coverage on the new module, full workspace suite
green. Out of scope per the ball: Deps wiring + dispatch loop refactor
(bl-9221), wire ContentBlock::ToolUse/ToolResult (bl-8be5), bash and
read_file built-ins (bl-ecf1, bl-a96a).
